# Private Agent Search

> Cited search + grounded answers over private, specialized document collections (RAG).

## Product

- [Home](https://knowledgebase.sassmaker.com/): Private cited search workspace

## Machine surfaces

- [Agent catalog](https://knowledgebase.sassmaker.com/api/ai): JSON inventory of public surfaces
- [OpenAPI spec](https://knowledgebase.sassmaker.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable API description
- [Homepage markdown](https://knowledgebase.sassmaker.com/index.md): Product brief without JS
- [This index](https://knowledgebase.sassmaker.com/llms.txt)

## When to use this

- Performing cited search over private, specialized document collections with RAG
- Getting grounded answers with (file_id, page, excerpt) provenance for agent workflows
- Searching research papers, legal documents, contracts, or manuals with explicit schemas
- Building agent pipelines that require cited evidence rather than ungrounded LLM output

## Optional

- [Foundry](https://sassmaker.com): Parent fleet showcase
